clips.text: Threshold. Paced recovery after concussion. Tap to continue.
Read this first. This paces exercise and keeps a log. It does not diagnose or clear return to sport. Tap I understand.
When did the injury happen? Enter the date and your age, then continue.
Optional questions about you. Answer to set expectations, or skip.
Your outlook. This is not a diagnosis. Tap Start when ready.
Daily check-in. Start with audio, or without.
Log symptoms first. A session needs today’s rating. Start with audio, or without.
Overall. Zero is fine. Ten is worst. Choose, then save.
Before you start. Any red flags right now? None of these, or one or more apply.
Stop. Do not exercise. Get medical help now. Call emergency services. Or say you’ve got help to go back.
Not today. Symptoms 8 out of 10. Above the safe level for exercise. Log symptoms instead, or go back.
Before you start. Right now 3 out of 10. Target 120 to 140. Start warmup when ready.
Connect a chest strap, or use the camera instead.
Lock your pulse. Remove your phone case if you have one. Cover camera and flash. When a number appears, hold still about three seconds, then hands free.
Quick pulse check. Remove your phone case if needed. Cover camera and flash briefly, then continue.
Warmup. Ease in gently. Skip to target when ready, or stop.
Steady state. Target 120 to 140. Hold here. Dim the screen, or stop.
Glance mode. Heart rate on screen. Tap to return.
After session. How do you feel now? Choose a rating, then save.
One hour later. How do you feel now? Choose a rating on the same scale.
Settings. Voice guide and theme. Open recovery log for your clinician. Back when done.
Recovery log. Timeline of check-ins and sessions for your clinician. Not medical advice.
Today. Day 1. Level 2. Log symptoms before you start a session.
Today. Day 1. Level 2. Symptoms logged. Start session, or log again.
Maintenance mode. Day 10. Log symptoms today. No prescribed exercise.
Maintenance mode. Day 10. Symptoms logged. Log again anytime.
Moving up to level 3. Symptoms stayed inside the rule. See you tomorrow.
Staying at level 3. Try again tomorrow.
Level 5. Stable session 1 of 3. See you tomorrow.
Level 5. Stable session 2 of 3. See you tomorrow.
Progression complete. Three stable Level 5 sessions done. Maintenance mode starts tomorrow. Symptom check-in only.
